info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Matter Contacts API
Return the related contact data for a single matter

params.name: custom_field_ids[]
params.description: IDs of custom fields to include in results.

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of MatterContacts records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the MatterContacts records by the given field. Note that `id` is ordered by the `id` of the nested Relationship record. Default: `is_client(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

items.docs: Outlines the parameters, optional and required, used when requesting the data for all MatterContacts
